description: This file implements the MediaFrameWriterV2 class, which handles writing media segment data and associated metadata into shared memory buffers, including serialization of metadata using protobuf, and conversion functions for media segment attributes.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV2
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and their metadata into shared memory buffers, supporting different media segment types and serialization.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV2
methods.description: Constructor initializing the writer with shared memory buffer and media info, setting up metadata version and zeroing memory.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory, including metadata serialization and data copying, with error handling for insufficient space or serialization failures.

methods.name: buildMetadata
methods.description: Builds protobuf metadata for a given media segment, including media-specific attributes and encryption info.
